title: From Clinical Question to PICO in Five Minutes

hook.en: "Does exercise help back pain?" is not a question you can search for. "In adults with chronic low back pain, does supervised exercise reduce pain more than advice alone at three months?" is. Learn how to turn a worry into a question that finds an answer.
hook.ur: "Kya exercise peeth dard mein madad karti hai?" aisa sawal nahi jo dhoondha ja sake. "Chronic low back pain wale baalighon mein kya supervised exercise teen mahine mein sirf mashware se zyada dard kam karti hai?" dhoondha ja sakta hai. Seekhein ke fikr ko aise sawal mein kaise badlein jo jawab dhoondh sake.

goal.en: By the end, you'll turn a vague clinical worry into a PICO question, pick the right question type (therapy, diagnosis, prognosis, harm), and use the question to choose search words and the study design you need.
goal.ur: End tak aap mubham clinical fikr ko PICO sawal mein badlenge, sahi sawal ki qism (therapy, diagnosis, prognosis, harm) chunenge, aur sawal se search ke alfaaz aur zaroori study design chunenge.

text.en: **PICO** stands for **P**atient or problem, **I**ntervention, **C**omparison and **O**utcome. A good question names who the patients are, what you plan to do, what you compare it with and what result matters, ideally to the patient. Writing the question first keeps you from drowning in papers, and tells you which kind of study can answer it.
text.ur: **PICO** ka matlab hai **P**atient ya masla, **I**ntervention, **C**omparison aur **O**utcome. Achha sawal batata hai ke mareez kaun hain, aap kya karna chahte hain, kis se muqabla hai aur kaun sa nateeja ahem hai, behtar hai mareez ke liye. Pehle sawal likhna aap ko papers mein doobne se bachata hai, aur batata hai ke kaun si study jawab de sakti hai.

text.en: Think of a **GPS**. Typing "restaurant" gives you hundreds of results. Typing "halal biryani, open now, within 2 km" gives you the one you want. PICO is how you give your search the coordinates.
text.ur: **GPS** ko sochein. "Restaurant" likhne se saikron natije aate hain. "Halal biryani, abhi khula, 2 km ke andar" likhne se woh milta hai jo chahiye. PICO aap ki search ko coordinates dene ka tareeqa hai.

title.en: Turn a worry into a PICO question
title.ur: Fikr ko PICO sawal mein badlein

steps.title: Start with the patient's problem
steps.detail: Write the worry in plain words: "Will manual therapy help older patients with knee osteoarthritis walk better?" || Mareez ke masle se shuru karein

steps.title: Fill in P, I, C and O
steps.detail: P: adults over 60 with knee osteoarthritis. I: manual therapy plus exercise. C: exercise alone. O: walking distance and pain at 12 weeks. || P, I, C aur O bharein

steps.title: Pick the question type
steps.detail: Therapy (does it work?), diagnosis (how accurate is the test?), prognosis (what will happen?), harm (is it safe?) or experience (what is it like?). || Sawal ki qism chunein

steps.title: Turn it into search words
steps.detail: List the key words and their synonyms for each part, then combine with AND between parts and OR between synonyms. || Search ke alfaaz banayein

title.en: The same worry as four different question types
title.ur: Ek hi fikr, chaar mukhtalif sawal ki qismein

rows.en: In adults with frozen shoulder, does stretching plus injection improve function more than stretching alone?
rows.ur: Frozen shoulder wale baalighon mein kya stretching aur injection sirf stretching se zyada function behtar karte hain?

rows.en: Randomised trial, or a systematic review of trials
rows.ur: Randomised trial, ya trials ka systematic review

rows.en: In patients with shoulder pain, how accurate is the painful arc sign for rotator cuff tear?
rows.ur: Kandhe ke dard wale mareezon mein painful arc sign rotator cuff tear ke liye kitna durust hai?

rows.en: In people with a first ankle sprain, what proportion have pain at six months?
rows.ur: Pehli takhne ki moch wale logon mein kitne chhe mahine par dard rakhte hain?

rows.en: In older adults, does neck manipulation increase the risk of serious adverse events?
rows.ur: Buzurgon mein kya gardan manipulation seriyas adverse events ka khatra barhati hai?

rows.en: How do patients with chronic pain experience group exercise classes?
rows.ur: Chronic dard wale mareez group exercise classes ka tajurba kaisa mehsoos karte hain?

question.en: Which question is best framed as a PICO question?
question.ur: Kaun sa sawal PICO sawal ke taur par behtareen hai?

text.en: In adults with chronic neck pain, does a six-week home exercise programme reduce pain more than advice alone at three months?
text.ur: Chronic gardan dard wale baalighon mein kya chhe haftay ki ghar ki exercise programme teen mahine mein sirf mashware se zyada dard kam karti hai?

feedback.en: Yes — it names the patients, the intervention, the comparison and the outcome with a time point.
feedback.ur: Haan — is mein mareez, intervention, comparison aur outcome waqt ke saath maujood hain.

text.ur: Kya exercise aap ke liye achhi hai?

text.en: Why do people get neck pain?
text.ur: Logon ko gardan dard kyun hota hai?

feedback.en: That is an open question, not a PICO comparison.
feedback.ur: Yeh khula sawal hai, PICO comparison nahi.

question.en: A therapist asks, "How accurate is the Lachman test for ACL tears?" What type of question is this and what design answers it?
question.ur: Therapist poochhta hai, "ACL tears ke liye Lachman test kitna durust hai?" Yeh sawal ki kaun si qism hai aur kaun sa design jawab deta hai?

text.en: Diagnosis; a diagnostic accuracy study or a review of such studies
text.ur: Diagnosis; diagnostic accuracy study ya aisi studies ka review

feedback.en: Yes — questions about test accuracy need studies that compare the test with a reference standard.
feedback.ur: Haan — test ki durusti ke sawal aise studies chahte hain jo test ko reference standard se milate hain.

feedback.en: The question is about numbers, not stories.
feedback.ur: Sawal ginti ke baare mein hai, kahaniyon ke nahi.

feedback.en: A test is not a treatment.

question.en: Which part of PICO does "at 12 weeks, pain on a 0 to 10 scale" belong to?
question.ur: "12 haftay par, 0 se 10 scale par dard" PICO ke kis hissay mein aata hai?

feedback.ur: Yeh batata hai kya naapa jata hai.

feedback.en: Yes — it states what is measured and when.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh batata hai kya naapa jaye aur kab.

feedback.en: It is not the treatment itself.

text.en: **Making the question too broad, too narrow or answering it in your head.** "Does physio work?" is too broad. A question so narrow that no study exists is a trap. Also, do not choose the comparison after you see the results. Write the question down first, then search. If no one has studied it, look for the nearest question that has been.
text.ur: **Sawal ko bohat wasi, bohat tang karna ya zehan mein hi jawab dena.** "Kya physio kaam karti hai?" bohat wasi hai. Itna tang sawal ke koi study hi na ho jaal hai. Aur nateeje dekhne ke baad comparison na chunein. Pehle sawal likhein, phir search karein. Agar kisi ne study na ki ho to sab se qareeb sawal dhoondhein jo hua ho.

text.en: **Do it with the patient.** Ask: "What would you like to be able to do again, and how will we know?" That is your outcome. Then the question you search for matches what the patient wants, not only what is easy to measure.
text.ur: **Mareez ke saath karein.** Poochhein: "Aap dobara kya karne ke qabil hona chahte hain, aur hum kaise jaanenge?" Yeh aap ka outcome hai. Phir jo sawal aap search karte hain woh mareez ki khwahish se milta hai, sirf us se nahi jo naapna aasaan hai.

question.en: Do you always need all four letters of PICO?
question.ur: Kya aap ko PICO ke chaaron harf hamesha chahiye?

answer.en: No. A question about prognosis may have no intervention or comparison, and a question about experience may use other frameworks such as PEO (population, exposure, outcome). PICO is a thinking aid, not a rule: the goal is a clear question, not four tidy boxes.
answer.ur: Nahi. Prognosis ke sawal mein intervention ya comparison na ho sakta hai, aur tajurbe ke sawal PEO (population, exposure, outcome) jaise doosre frameworks istemal kar sakte hain. PICO sochne ka madadgar hai, qaanoon nahi: maqsad saaf sawal hai, chaar saaf dibbe nahi.

beats.patient: A therapist sees an older man with a stiff shoulder after a stroke and wonders whether early mobilisation helps. She writes: "Is mobilisation good for stroke shoulder?"
beats.assessment: The question is vague. It does not say which patients, what mobilisation, what comparison or what outcome.
beats.treatment: She rewrites it: "In adults after stroke with shoulder pain, does regular shoulder positioning and gentle range of motion reduce pain at eight weeks compared with usual care?" and chooses key words for each letter.
beats.reassess: Her search finds relevant trials and a review in 15 minutes instead of a hundred unrelated papers.

text.en: **A good question includes safety.** Add "harm" to your thinking: what could go wrong with this treatment, and in whom? Searching only for benefits gives an optimistic picture. Do not pick outcomes that avoid the problems, such as only short-term pain when long-term harm matters.
text.ur: **Achhe sawal mein safety shamil hoti hai.** "Harm" ko apni soch mein shamil karein: is ilaaj mein kya ghalat ho sakta hai, aur kis mein? Sirf faide dhoondhne se tasveer khush-fehmi wali milti hai. Aise outcomes na chunein jo masail se bachayein, jaise sirf mukhtasar muddat ka dard jabke lambay waqt ka nuqsan ahem ho.

text.en: The well-built clinical question described by Richardson and colleagues set out the idea that a question has parts: the patient or problem, the intervention, a comparison and the clinical outcome, and that building the question this way makes finding answers easier. A later evaluation of PICO as a way to represent clinical questions found that the elements were common in real questions, though not every question has every element, and some need extra concepts, so PICO is best used flexibly.
text.ur: Richardson aur saathiyon ke bayan kiye gaye achhe tarah banaye clinical sawal ka khayal yeh tha ke sawal ke hissay hote hain: mareez ya masla, intervention, comparison aur clinical outcome, aur sawal is tarah banane se jawab dhoondhna aasaan hota hai. PICO ko clinical sawalon ki numainda-gi ke tor par jaanchne wali baad ki ek tashkhees ne paya ke asal sawalon mein yeh ajza aam thay, halaanke har sawal mein har juz nahi hota, aur kuch ko mazeed concepts chahiye, isliye PICO ko lachak ke saath istemal karna behtar hai.

text.en: **Who, What, Versus what, So what.** Patient, Intervention, Comparison, Outcome: the four questions behind every good clinical question.
text.ur: **Kaun, Kya, Kis ke muqable, Phir kya.** Patient, Intervention, Comparison, Outcome: har achhe clinical sawal ke peechay chaar sawal.

summary.en: PICO turns a vague worry into a searchable question: patient, intervention, comparison, outcome.
summary.ur: PICO mubham fikr ko search ke qabil sawal banata hai: patient, intervention, comparison, outcome.

summary.en: Pick the question type first; therapy, diagnosis, prognosis, harm and experience each need a different study design.
summary.ur: Pehle sawal ki qism chunein; therapy, diagnosis, prognosis, harm aur tajurba ko mukhtalif study design chahiye.

summary.en: Write the question before you search, and include harm, not only benefit.
summary.ur: Search se pehle sawal likhein, aur sirf faida nahi, harm bhi shamil karein.

back.en: Patient or problem, Intervention, Comparison, Outcome.
back.ur: Patient ya masla, Intervention, Comparison, Outcome.

front.en: Which design best answers a therapy question?
front.ur: Therapy ke sawal ka behtareen design kaun sa?

back.en: A randomised trial or a systematic review of trials.
back.ur: Randomised trial ya trials ka systematic review.

front.en: Which design best answers a prognosis question?
front.ur: Prognosis ke sawal ka behtareen design kaun sa?

front.en: Do you always need all four PICO parts?
front.ur: Kya PICO ke chaaron hissay hamesha chahiye?

back.en: No; PICO is a flexible aid, and some questions need other frameworks.
back.ur: Nahi; PICO lachakdar madadgar hai, aur kuch sawalon ko doosre frameworks chahiye.

note.ur: Study milne ke baad kya karein.
Diagnostic sawalon ke peechay ke numbers.
